title: MKeepUp
description: A fully configurable lobby game mode where players must keep blocks in the air by shooting them – including a scoreboard and modern features.
body:
# MKeepUp

MKeepUp brings a fast-paced and addictive lobby minigame to your Minecraft server!

The goal is simple:
Keep the blocks in the air for as long as possible by shooting them and achieve the highest score.

Perfect for lobbies, minigame servers, SMPs, or community servers. The plugin offers a modern gameplay experience with scoreboards, statistics, and many customization options.

## Features

* Unique KeepUp game mode
* Keep blocks in the air by shooting them
* Live scoreboard system
* Highscore & statistics system
* Fully configurable
* Performance optimized
* No watermarks
* Modern and fast-paced gameplay
* Customizable messages and settings
* Stable and efficient code
* Easy setup

## Gameplay

Players must try to keep the blocks in the air for as long as possible by shooting or hitting them.

The longer the blocks stay in the air:

* the higher the score
* the harder the gameplay becomes
* the better the highscores

## Why MKeepUp?

* Perfect for lobby servers
* Ideal for short play sessions
* Very high replay value
* Modern design
* Lightweight and performant
* Optimized for modern Minecraft versions

## Use Cases

* Lobby minigame
* Community servers
* SMP entertainment
* Arcade systems
* Highscore competitions
* Event servers
